verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a first-party mobile SDK for the Embedded components onramp, and Stripe's llms.txt refers to installable Stripe packages on npm, so official SDKs exist for at least part of the crypto surface. Depth is thin: there is no documented server-side SDK coverage of the stablecoin payments, payouts, or Treasury APIs. Missing for 10: documented official server-side SDKs (languages and versions) covering stablecoin payments and payouts, SDK reference docs for the crypto features, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use the Embedded components onramp (mobile SDK) to let your customers check out directly in your application.
When installing Stripe packages, always check the npm registry for the latest version
